name: Brenda McPherson
bio:
Brenda McPherson's journey into the world of motorsport began unexpectedly. A skilled automotive painter from Detroit, she was headhunted by a local racing team for her meticulous work and ability to create vibrant, lasting finishes. Over the years, Brenda honed her craft, mastering the art of applying complex liveries and protective coatings that withstand the rigors of high-speed racing. 

Brenda approaches her role with a blend of precision and artistry. She understands the importance of a flawless paint job, not only for aesthetics but also for aerodynamic performance. Her keen eye for detail and collaborative spirit make her an invaluable asset to the team, always ready to share her knowledge and mentor younger members. Brenda's loyalty to Porsche Penske is unwavering; she sees the team as her extended family and takes immense pride in contributing to their success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob, often tucked behind her ears.
physical.description: Brenda has a strong, kind face framed by reading glasses.

quirks: Always has a perfectly sharpened set of colored pencils on her desk.
Insists on using only natural bristle brushes for fine detailing.
Plays classical music quietly in the paint shop to maintain focus.
